title: Aria
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the 24th century, Mars has been terraformed into the ocean planet Aqua, and its city Neo-Venezia recreates Venice. Akari Mizunashi moves from Earth to train as an Undine, a gondolier guide, at the small Aria Company under her mentor Alicia. Each chapter is a gentle episode of friendship, seasons and small wonders, including the mysterious cat Cait Sith, until Akari becomes a full Prima.
life_message: Happiness is found by noticing the small, beautiful things of each day and sharing them with others.

content.note: Mild mysterious episodes with Cait Sith and the city's 'Seven Mysteries'.
